name: Horse
description: Anatomy and attachment repair: embedded ear roots, contoured skull/jaw/muzzle/neck/barrel/legs, fitted harness and continuous straps. Owner approved the second anatomy revision; final changes only raise the browband and move cheek straps behind/below both eyes. All 16 pivots, four clip names (Stand/Gallop plus aliases), 68 native animation channels and original pinned material bytes preserved. Original author Claude Fable 5.1 (owner-directed), cli, remains in parent provenance. Refiner gpt-6-astra/codex; requested reasoning max, runtime identity/effort not exposed. Project revision 2 record unchanged. Sampled inherited Gallop ground penetration remains documented in output/RESULT.json.
